rory: Quick note — launching community-maintainers sprint and a maintenance release for community-model-zoo v0.2.1 :tada:

rory: Release link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-model-zoo/releases/tag/v0.2.1

rory: Fixes: model tag stability, improved model-card metadata, added CONTRIBUTING.md for eval runners.

ana: awesome. who handles tagging & backporting for the older v0.2 branch?

sam: I'll handle backports. Will open PRs for the model-card schema fixes.

devex-bot: Reminder: maintainers office hours Friday 09:00 PT in #devex — drop-in for onboarding new maintainers.

ci-bot: CI: small release pipeline passed (build+lint+smoke). Nightly regression scheduled.

rory: We're also running a 2-week maintainer sprint: goals = triage backlog, update docs, add 2 quickstart notebooks. If you want to be listed, reply here.

ana: I'll add a short troubleshooting FAQ to the repo and flag any license questions.

sam: minor ask: please don't copy internal datasets into example notebooks — use synthetic or public datasets only. I'll add a checklist.

rory: Thanks — will update the release notes and CODEOWNERS. :shipit:
